name: engine-sources
description: The engine port's reference is the engine block in reference/crafter.html (RUNES, SHAPES, TRIGGERS, TETHERS, HOOKS, canonical form, compile-to-steps). It is out of date (old ring entries; Push and Pull still runes). Where it disagrees with docs/design/ (spell-model.md, effect-flags-checklist.md), the docs win. engine/ stays pure: no imports from app/, React or Next.js, no JSX files, no DOM (tests/guards/engine-purity.test.ts).
With jsx: react-jsx, a .tsx file uses React through the automatic runtime with no import statement, so an import-matching purity guard cannot see it.
resolution: The engine has no UI: tests/guards/engine-purity.ts refuses .tsx/.jsx under engine/ by path, not by import patterns.
